# Input Otp

```tsx
import { InputOTP, InputOTPGroup, InputOTPSlot, InputOTPSeparator } from "@lucasdost/design-system"
```

Serve para inserir códigos de verificação segmentados, distribuindo cada caractere em campos individuais.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<InputOTP
  {...args}
  onChange={(value: string) => {
    updateArgs({ value })
    onChange(value)
  }}
>
  {separated ? (
    <>
      <InputOTPGroup>{slots(0, half)}</InputOTPGroup>
      <InputOTPSeparator />
      <InputOTPGroup>{slots(half, args.maxLength)}</InputOTPGroup>
    </>
  ) : undefined}
</InputOTP>
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Input OTP component: Filled × Error, with one .Input OTP Item per character (56px square, 16px apart). The Active item shows the Focus ring 2px away from its border and the .Type Indicator caret; Error paints the Focus Error ring on every item. Label, Text Help and Text Error come from the shared Input pieces, as do the Disabled and Read Only colors.

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`InputOTPProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `className?` | `string` | Classes for the root, around the label, items and messages. |
| `children?` | `React.ReactNode` | Custom groups and items; one group with `maxLength` items by default. |

## Types

`InputOTPProps`

## Rules

- Import `InputOTP` from `@lucasdost/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
